Human-in-the-loop by default. The agent drafts; the staff member sends. That single choice removes the 标识 disclosure question for one-to-one chat, keeps the liability with a human,
and produces a free quality metric (draft-acceptance rate and edit distance) that tells you immediately whether the prompts and the retrieval are working.
